(Pleasant Hill, California) | college = * [[UC Riverside Highlanders men's basketball|UC Riverside]] (2019–2023) * [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]] (2023–2024) | draftyear = 2024 | career_start = 2024 | years1 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024–2025]] | team1 = [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]] | years2 = {{nbay|2024|end}} | team2 = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | years3 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2025]] | team3 = →[[Memphis Hustle]] | years4 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–2026]] | team4 = →[[Iowa Wolves]] | years5 = {{nbay|2025|end}}–present | team5 = [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] | years6 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]]–present | team6 = →Iowa Wolves | highlights = *First-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2024) *First-team All-[[Big West]] (2023) *Second-team All-Big West (2022) }} '''Zyon Pullin''' (born March 3, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] of the [[National Basketball Association]], on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Iowa Wolves]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UC Riverside Highlanders men's basketball|UC Riverside Highlanders]] and [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]]. ==Early life and high school career== Pullin grew up in [[Pleasant Hill, California]] and attended [[College Park High School (Pleasant Hill, California)|College Park High School]].{{cite web|first=Theo|last=Lawson|title=UC Riverside transfer Zyon Pullin includes Gonzaga in top five|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2023/may/31/uc-riverside-transfer-zyon-pullin-includes-gonzaga/|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=May 31, 2023|access-date=June 24, 2024}} ==College career== Pullin began his college career at [[UC Riverside Highlanders men's basketball|UC Riverside]]. He averaged 14.3 points, 5.6 rebounds, and 4.3 assists per game and was named second-team All-[[Big West]] during his junior season.{{cite web|title=NBA 2024 Draft Prospects: Zyon Pullin|url=https://www.nba.com/draft/2024/prospects/zyon-pullin|website=NBA.com|access-date=June 25, 2024}} Pullin was named first-team All-Big West as a senior after averaging 18.3 points, 4.4 rebounds and 4.2 assists per game as the Highlanders had their winningest season ever.{{cite web|first=Andrew|last=Kahn|title=Michigan basketball in mix for transfer from UC Riverside|url=https://www.mlive.com/wolverines/2023/06/michigan-basketball-in-mix-for-transfer-from-uc-riverside.html|website=MLive.com|date=June 1, 2023|access-date=June 25, 2024}} After the season, Pullin decided to utilize the extra year of eligibility granted to college athletes who played in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020 season]] due to [[COVID-19 pandemic]] and entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|title=All-Big West guard Zyon Pullin expected to enter transfer portal|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/37669774|website=ESPN.com|date=May 17, 2023|access-date=June 24, 2024}} Pullin transferred to Florida.{{cite web|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|title=Florida lands UC Riverside transfer point guard Zyon Pullin|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/37814993|website=ESPN.com|date=June 7, 2023|access-date=June 24, 2024}} He was suspended for the first three games of the season by the NCAA for his participation in the 2023 [[Portsmouth Invitational Tournament]], a non-sanctioned offseason tournament for recently graduated players pursuing a professional career.{{Cite web |last=Brockway |first=Kevin |date=September 29, 2023 |title=Florida basketball PG Zyon Pullin suspended 3 games by NCAA |url=https://www.gainesville.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2023/09/29/florda-gators-basketball-pg-zyon-pullin-suspended-3-games-by-ncaa/70997115007/ |access-date=June 25, 2024 |website=[[Gainesville Sun]]}} Pullin was named first-team All-[[Southeastern Conference]] in his only season with the Gators after averaging 15.5 points and 4.9 assists per game.{{cite web|first=Barkley|last=Truax|title=Report: Florida guard Zyon Pullin receives invite to G League Elite Camp|url=https://www.on3.com/pro/news/florida-guard-zyon-pullin-receives-invite-to-g-league-elite-camp/|website=On3.com|date=May 6, 2024|access-date=June 25, 2024}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2024 NBA draft]], Pullin signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Miami Heat]] on July 1, 2024.{{cite web|title=HEAT SIGN ZYON PULLIN TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-sign-zyon-pullin-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=July 1, 2024|access-date=July 1, 2024}} However, he was waived on July 25{{cite web|title=HEAT SIGN JOSH CHRISTOPHER TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-sign-josh-christopher-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=July 25, 2024|access-date=July 25, 2024}} and signed an Exhibit 10 contract on August 5,{{cite web|title=HEAT SIGN ZYON PULLIN|url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-sign-zyon-pullin|website=NBA.com|date=August 5, 2024|access-date=August 5, 2024}} being later waived on October 19.{{cite web|title=HEAT WAIVE LITTLE, PULLIN, STEVENS AND WASHINGTON|url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-waive-little-pullin-stevens-and-washington|website=NBA.com|date=October 19, 2024|access-date=October 21, 2024}} On October 28, he joined the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]].{{cite web|title=Skyforce Announces Training Camp Roster Ahead of 2024-25 Season|url=https://siouxfalls.gleague.nba.com/news/skyforce-announces-training-camp-roster-ahead-of-2024-25-season|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=October 31, 2024}} On January 10, 2025, Pullin signed a two-way contract with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{cite web|title=Grizzlies sign Zyon Pullin to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-zyon-pullin-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=January 10, 2025|access-date=January 11, 2025}} Pullin played three games for the Grizzlies, scoring no points. In eleven G League games for the [[Memphis Hustle]], Pullin averaged 18.8 points per game. Pullin was waived by the Grizzlies on November 20, following the signing of [[PJ Hall (basketball)|PJ Hall]].{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies sign PJ Hall to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-pj-hall-to-two-way-contract|access-date=December 4, 2025|website=nba.com|language=en}} On November 6, 2025, Pullin was named to the [[Iowa Wolves]]' opening night roster.{{cite web|url=https://iowa.gleague.nba.com/news/iowa-wolves-announce-opening-night-roster|title=Iowa Wolves Announce Opening Night Roster|website=gleague.nba.com|date=November 6, 2025|access-date=November 6, 2025}} On March 2, 2026, Pullin signed a two-way contract with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{Cite web|title=Timberwolves Sign Zyon Pullin to Two-Way Contract|url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/timberwolves-sign-zyon-pullin-to-two-way-contract|access-date=March 7, 2026|website=noblesville.gleague.nba.com|language=en}}
